resolution_events.text: For the consideration of these expenses, the following applies:
For the consideration of these expenses
resolution_events.normalized: for the consideration of these expenses

resolution_events.text: a) For a one-way distance between the residence and the place of work of up to 20 km, these expenses are generally compensated by the transport tax credit (Section 33(5) and Section 57(3)).
For a one-way distance between the residence and the place of work of up to 20 km
resolution_events.normalized: for a one-way distance between the residence and the place of work of up to 20 km

resolution_events.text: b) If the one-way distance between the residence and the place of work predominantly travelled by the employee during the pay period exceeds 20 km and the use of public transport is reasonable, the following additional flat-rate amounts shall be taken into account:
If the one-way distance between the residence and the place of work predominantly travelled by the employee during the pay period exceeds 20 km and the use of public transport is reasonable
resolution_events.normalized: if the one-way distance between the residence and the place of work predominantly travelled by the employee during the pay period exceeds 20 km and the use of public transport is reasonable

resolution_events.text: c) If, during the pay period, the use of public transport between the residence and the place of work is predominantly not reasonable for the employee at least with regard to half of the distance, the following flat-rate amounts shall be taken into account instead of the flat-rate amounts under lit. b:
If, during the pay period, the use of public transport between the residence and the place of work is predominantly not reasonable for the employee at least with regard to half of the distance
resolution_events.normalized: if, during the pay period, the use of public transport between the residence and the place of work is predominantly not reasonable for the employee at least with regard to half of the distance

resolution_events.text: at least with regard to half of the distance
resolution_events.normalized: at least with regard to half of the distance

resolution_events.text: instead of the flat-rate amounts under lit. b
resolution_events.normalized: instead of the flat-rate amounts under lit. b
